fixes.implementation: One strict wire schema 2 and native route. Credits stays /user/credits, not /user/currencies. Exact defId/count=21/page=1; discovery maxBid=1000/minBuy=11000 is separate from pricing maxBuy -> maxb. No production 1000 bid ceiling. Identity/context/fences, positive allowlists, source freshness and UNKNOWN ambiguity are preserved.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE_VERIFIED only for subsequent R1/S1 fresh inventory/credits/status and S2 caps/helpers. New pricing search wire and final foundation live composition remain LIVE-UNVERIFIED.

fixes.implementation: Native exact-card caps plus absolute above/below helpers replace static approved-rule hashes and certification gates. Opening uses startingBid; rebid uses above(currentBid). Profit ceiling rounds down. Context/cap/coins/fresh-read and durable-intent checks remain.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE_VERIFIED read-only helpers and one exact-card caps GET for 261855: minimum 700, maximum 10500. Eight local evaluations include above(750)=800 and below(1500)=1400. Client helper availability is not transaction acceptance; new bid/list acceptance is LIVE-UNVERIFIED.

fixes.implementation: One-shot quote takes minimum valid independent BIN, excluding paired 600/10000 templates without dropping genuine 1500/1700 offers. First-cap candidate rejection uses one search; eligible misses use exactly two with inclusive maxBuy=first_min. Successful empty second differs from failure/ambiguity. Completed-only durable 86400-second account/game/platform/version cache uses zero searches on hit. last_sale_price is diagnostic only; fixed resale BIN and 5% tax determine cap.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE-UNVERIFIED for new two-search production quote/cache integration. Retained 261855 first page independently demonstrates minimum 1500 rather than old modeled 2800; no new live searches were run.

fixes.implementation: Dirty INBOX/PURCHASED/TRANSFER before watched/unassigned/transfer_list; strict actual authenticated fresh GET and independent command IDs. Bulk identity/native states retained. Missing row -> UNKNOWN; closed/highest -> PENDING until independent owned-item proof. Lite definition 0/null is unobserved, not a mismatched card.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE_VERIFIED R1: four GET 200s; watched 1 row, unassigned 0, transfer list 8, balance 16268. This proves these bounded fresh reads only. Completeness, a win, paid cost and 50-slot capacity remain LIVE-UNVERIFIED.

fixes.implementation: KnownTrade lookup requires retained full trade/item/version in the same document and reviewed getAuctionData source. Native IDs stay page-local. Reconnect clears mappings; fresh full-identity read is required. Lite rows cannot overwrite full-version proof.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE_VERIFIED for one retained current-document trade: full watched plus status GET 200, closed/outbid/current_bid=1200, definition_id=0. Reconnect local inspection showed retained_count=0 and sent zero EA requests. Lookup after reacquisition and unresolved enrolled-trade outcomes remain LIVE-UNVERIFIED.

fixes.implementation: Standalone validation fixes BIN=resale_price and start=below(resale_price), checks reciprocal legal prices inside exact-card limits. No legal lower start -> UNLISTABLE; missing/conflicting evidence -> NEEDS_RECONCILIATION. No listing dispatcher exists in production.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE_VERIFIED only as local client arithmetic plus authenticated caps: 1500/1400 lies within observed 700..10500. Server listing acceptance, ownership, chosen duration, unsold/relisting and settlement remain LIVE-UNVERIFIED.

fixes.implementation: Foundation composes adapter -> native prices/quote -> admission -> serial prioritized scheduler -> durable journal/registry. Admission records BID eligibility without dispatch. Explicit bid seam requires durable INTENT_DURABLE/PENDING before send. Restart/dropped result stays UNKNOWN, duplicates cannot retry, old epochs are fenced. Append-only registry, spendable balance, reservations, deadlines and separate delivery/native metrics are retained. No actor loops.
fixes.bounded_read_only: LIVE-UNVERIFIED for final foundation composition. Only finite fixtures, including 2500 bid under 10750 cap, priority/deadlines/crashes/reconciliation. Local service 127.0.0.1:8784 is still separately required; default service rejects mutations. No live actors or bids.

dependencies.prerequisite: A real enrolled auction where this account is actively outbid before expiry.
dependencies.missing_operation: Observe active personal outbid, compute the smallest native legal rebid under the stored profitable cap, durably dispatch once and independently read back.
dependencies.required_evidence: Fresh exact auction and spendable coins, intent/PUT amount, post-write watched/status and coins; leading must HOLD without a write.

dependencies.prerequisite: A naturally won competitive auction from an enrolled trade.
dependencies.missing_operation: Correlate terminal trade with independent exact owned physical item and actual paid acquisition cost.
dependencies.required_evidence: Full version/trade/item identity plus purchased or owned readback and independent balance/paid-cost reconciliation; closed/highest or isWon alone remains PENDING.

dependencies.prerequisite: Confirmed competitive ownership and paid cost, plus chosen listing duration.
dependencies.missing_operation: Implement the production move/list lifecycle; list fixed sampled BIN with starting bid exactly one native tick below, read back the listing and later sale settlement.
dependencies.required_evidence: Durable move/list commands, exact physical item readbacks, sale/settled proceeds, tax, paid cost and realized profit. Objective 001 Buy Now evidence does not prove this branch.

dependencies.prerequisite: Independent Python Acquirer/Bidder ownership, scheduling and real queue demand.
dependencies.missing_operation: Implement recurring 600-second discovery and near-25-second prioritized Bidder polling, reconnect handling and practical 50-slot watchlist coverage.
dependencies.required_evidence: Sustained cycle/latency/priority/deadline metrics under Acquirer load, truncation and expiry checks; fifty mocked rows and finite scheduler runs prove no live capacity guarantee.

dependencies.prerequisite: Natural near-expiry competitive bidding and held-funds transitions.
dependencies.missing_operation: Observe timer extensions/resets and transient debit/hold/refund timing independently over the natural auction lifecycle.
dependencies.required_evidence: Timestamped exact-trade expires/state plus spendable/held balance observations; historical 800 debit/return is only one observed case.

dependencies.prerequisite: A full exact native mapping reacquired after document/epoch change for a real enrolled trade.
dependencies.missing_operation: Reacquire full identity, then correlate a new status GET; reconcile unresolved or missing enrolled trades without blind retries.
dependencies.required_evidence: Same complete context/namespace, exact trade/item/full version and independent read IDs. Missing mapping or row remains UNKNOWN; lite version 0/null is VERSION_UNOBSERVED.

dependencies.prerequisite: A retained native trade ID in the same identity namespace with independent exact physical identity.
dependencies.missing_operation: Resolve historical enrolled-trade status only when its mapping exists; never infer a native ID or cross-key identity from pseudonyms.
dependencies.required_evidence: Full identity plus read-only known-status evidence, otherwise explicit UNKNOWN. One R1/S1 row does not resolve unrelated 001C pseudonyms or newly enrolled trades.

dependencies.prerequisite: Product decisions for listing duration, unsold handling and relisting policy.
dependencies.missing_operation: Define duration, expiry detection, whether/when to relist, price policy and retry/reconciliation rules before implementing unsold/relisting actions.
dependencies.required_evidence: Approved rules plus exact unsold-item/listing readback and a later observed relist/settlement; no invented rules in 001D.

dependencies.prerequisite: A separately authorized bounded read-only window; the unused R2 allowance is not automatically a new window.
dependencies.missing_operation: Observe new production pricing search with exact defId/page 1/count 21, then inclusive maxBuy=first_min emitted as maxb, if the candidate remains eligible.
dependencies.required_evidence: Correlated fresh authenticated sanitized wire captures with criteria and exclusions; native mocks and old 001C maxb evidence do not prove the new route live.

dependencies.prerequisite: The final foundation composed with its separate localhost service and reviewed attached official FC27 PC tab.
dependencies.missing_operation: Run a separately authorized finite read/quote/admission integration with the final foundation and retain independent native results; do not call bid in 001D.
dependencies.required_evidence: Current attachment/persona/authentication/native-result gates and finite registry/quote evidence. D5 fixtures do not prove final live service composition.
